answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks through environmental sensor attestation. Agents authenticate by submitting ambient telemetry synchronized with a cryptographic beacon. Correlating microclimate data across varied physical sites, from a mountain timber canopy to a subterranean karst fissure, forces an adversary to maintain dedicated hardware sensors in separate geographic zones per identity. However, localized weather anomalies can cause honest agents to fail validation.
